notes.title: Every picture tells a story...
notes.content: [h3]The new, old world of Simon the Sorcerer: Origins[/h3][p]Set in the weeks before the events of the original 1993 hit, [b]Simon The Sorcerer Origins[/b] invites players to venture back into the world of sarcasm, spells, and sublime storytelling. This magical prequel offers fans old and new a visually rich and hilariously twisted fantasy journey.[/p][h3]Speaking of visually rich[/h3][p]Inspired by late ‘90s and early 2000s Disney animation, the game boasts [b]over 15,000 hand-drawn frames[/b] and cinematic sequences crafted by some of the talented artists who worked on the Oscar-nominated film Klaus. With [b]50 entirely hand-drawn backgrounds and a fully animated cast of 15 unique characters[/b], Origins is a love letter to traditional 2D art, refined through months of rigorous visual design and testing.[/p][h3]Open your ears to the Music[/h3][p]Simon The Sorcerer Origins doesn’t just look the part—it sounds it too. [b]The game’s original score is composed by industry veteran Mason Fisher[/b], whose past work includes titles from the iconic Eye of the Beholder III to entries in the F.E.A.R. series. Fisher’s soundtrack blends whimsical fantasy with emotional depth, enhancing both the comedic and heartfelt moments of Simon’s journey. [/p][h3]Get ready to laugh[/h3][p]Voicing the ever-sarcastic Simon once again is [b]Chris Barrie[/b], the iconic British comedian and actor known for his role as Arnold Rimmer in iconic sci-fi sitcom Red Dwarf and as Hilary, Lara Croft’s eccentric butler, in the Tomb Raider film series. [b]Barrie originally lent his voice to Simon in the 90s and now returns[/b] after more than three decades to reprise the role, bringing his signature wit, timing, and unmistakable voice back to the character that fans first fell in love with.[/p][p][/p][h2]Go check out the new Trailer and take a first peek at the Story![/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="zkRq_XpDml8;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Look what we pulled out of the hat!
notes.content: [h3][i]Classic charm meets modern magic in the long-awaited prequel to one of the most iconic adventure games of all time.[/i][/h3][p][/p][p][b]ININ[/b] and [b]Smallthing Studios[/b] are proud to announce the upcoming release of [i][b]Simon the Sorcerer Origins[/b][/i] on October 28th![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="J28oQ1C9rGY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]With over three decades having passed since [i]Simon the Sorcerer[/i] first cast his spell on adventure game fans in 1993, [i][b]Simon the Sorcerer Origins[/b][/i] invites players to step back into the enchanting world of magic, sarcasm, and mystery – this time, to discover how it all began. [/p][p]Longtime fans will be thrilled to know that [b]the original voice actors return in both English (Chris Barrie) and German (Erik Borner)[/b], adding an extra layer of authenticity and nostalgia to this lovingly crafted origin story.[/p][p]The game features an [b]original soundtrack composed by Mason Fischer[/b], capturing the emotional range and whimsical tone of Simon’s magical world. And as a very special surprise, [i][b]Simon the Sorcerer Origins[/b][/i] includes [b]music icon Rick Astley[/b] in a special role, bringing a touch of 80s soul to the fantasy adventure.[/p][p]This prequel to one of the most beloved point-and-click legends will launch on [b]October 28, 2025[/b], and be available worldwide on all major platforms: Steam (PC, Mac, and Linux) with full Steam Deck compatibility, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, and 5, Xbox One, and Xbox Series S/X.[/p][p][i][b]Simon the Sorcerer Origins[/b][/i] brings the charming style of the ’90s into the modern era: hand-drawn graphics, clever puzzles, humorous and emotional storytelling – and of course, plenty of Simon’s trademark sarcasm.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]And for fans of physical games:[/u][/b][/p][p]Standard retail editions for Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 5, as well as a [b]Limited Special Edition[/b] for PC (Steam Key in Box), Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 5 are now available for pre-order exclusively at [url="http://iningames.com"][u]ININGAMES.COM[/u][/url]![/p][p]But even if you aren't interested in a box filled with Simon the Sorcerer goodies, go check it out anyway for some exclusive wallpapers and a sample of the original soundtrack, downloadable for free now![/p]

notes.title: SMALLTHING STUDIOS ANNOUNCE SIMON THE SORCERER ORIGINS
notes.content:
[p]We are opening a new chapter in video games history as they announce that [b]Simon the Sorcerer - Origins,[/b] the prequel to the original Simon the Sorcerer point and click adventure is currently in development for PC and consoles.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42405036/ecd80bf2c441df39043a821972ed122ae13def5d.jpg"][/img] The Simon the Sorcerer brand has entertained fans for almost 30 years and the launch of the Origins prequel will look to bring a fresh, modern reimagining of this classic adventure game franchise.   [/p][previewyoutube="88mR2bEUUyk;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
Simon the Sorcerer - Origins is the official prequel to the original Simon the Sorcerer game and transports players back to a few weeks before the events of the first episode. The game world is crafted with a modern visual style filled with seamless realtime sequences, magic and puzzle solving tied together with an engrossing storyline that will finally answer some important questions raised by fans from the first game. 

[b]Simon the Sorcerer - Origins[/b] will be coming to PC and consoles. Fans can wishlist the game on Steam now.[/p]
